notes: The focused C++ TCK uses only the official connection, federation-management, and callback APIs. One ambassador connects without an RtiConfiguration or RTI address and creates a uniquely named federation using the adapter-supplied FOM. A second ambassador supplies a unique nonexistent configuration name, no RTI address, and no additional settings; after Connect, List Federation Executions must report the federation created through the no-name path. The observed shared federation is the behavioral oracle that both paths selected the same implementation default. ConfigurationResult flags are deliberately not interpreted as a default-selection signal. The case does not assert a provider-specific configuration name, file, address, backend, or interoperability result.
